verdict: Paid campaigns have not launched; five overdue milestones are being resolved now.
narrative: No paid advertising ran this period — Meta and Google campaigns have not yet gone live, which means zero spend and zero paid leads across the full 28 days. Five pre-launch milestones that were due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete, and closing those is the immediate priority. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, delivering 76 actions (14 calls, 27 direction requests, 35 website visits) over the 28 days, though activity dropped sharply in the final week and is being looked into. Your intake pipeline holds 111 contacts and 7 open opportunities, so the infrastructure is in place to handle volume once traffic begins. Once the remaining launch steps are completed, paid campaigns will go live and the pipeline will begin receiving new leads.
